name: Summoner of Plaguebearers
text: At the end of any turn, pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit wholly within 14" of the general and return 1 slain model to it.

name: Gardener of Nurgle
text: In your movement phase, if the general contests an objective that no enemy model contests, roll a dice. On a 3+ the objective becomes desecrated for you. Friendly units have Ward (4+) while they contest a desecrated objective. It stops being desecrated when your opponent gains control of it.

name: Pestilent Breath
text: In your shooting phase, pick an enemy unit within 7" of the general and roll a dice for each model in it. Each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal damage on that unit. This is not a Shoot ability.

name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy
text: Once per battle, in any combat phase, until the end of the phase friendly units wholly within 7" of the general add 1 to the Attacks of their melee weapons. Companion weapons are not affected.
